+}

+function readbackMarkdown({ handoff, validatorResult }) {

+export function buildPostAttemptReviewPayloadFrontendHandoff(options = {}) {
+  const root = rootFromOptions(options);
+  const paths = pathsFromOptions(options);
+  const generatedAt = generatedAtFromOptions(options);
+  const inputs = loadInputs(root, paths);
+  const sourceArtifacts = buildSourceArtifacts({ root, paths, inputs });
+  const handoff = buildHandoff({
+    paths,
+    generatedAt,
+    sourceArtifacts,
+    inputs,
+  });
+  const validatorResult = validatePostAttemptReviewPayloadFrontendHandoff({
+    handoff,
+    sourceArtifacts,
+    frontendFixtures: inputs.frontendFixtures,
+    frontendFixtureManifest: inputs.frontendFixtureManifest,
+    rehearsalReceipt: inputs.rehearsalReceipt,
+    diagnostics: inputs.diagnostics,
+  });
+  const readback = readbackMarkdown({ handoff, validatorResult });
+  return {
+    handoff,
+    validatorResult,
+    readback,
+    inputs,
+    sourceArtifacts,
+    frontendFixtures: inputs.frontendFixtures,
+    frontendFixtureManifest: inputs.frontendFixtureManifest,
+    rehearsalReceipt: inputs.rehearsalReceipt,
+    sourceImagePosture: inputs.sourceImagePosture,
+    rightsDisplayGate: inputs.rightsDisplayGate,
+    feedbackPolicy: inputs.feedbackPolicy,
+  };
+}
+
+export function writePostAttemptReviewPayloadFrontendHandoffArtifacts({
+  outRoot,
+  artifacts,
+  paths = DEFAULT_PATHS,
+} = {}) {
+  if (!isString(outRoot)) throw new TypeError('outRoot is required');
+  if (!isRecord(artifacts)) throw new TypeError('artifacts are required');
+  const outPaths = {
+    handoffOut: artifacts.handoff?.output_artifacts?.handoff ?? paths.handoffOut,
+    validatorOut: artifacts.handoff?.output_artifacts?.validator ?? paths.validatorOut,
+    readbackOut: artifacts.handoff?.output_artifacts?.readback ?? paths.readbackOut,
+  };
+  writeJson(outRoot, outPaths.handoffOut, artifacts.handoff);
+  writeJson(outRoot, outPaths.validatorOut, artifacts.validatorResult);
+  writeText(outRoot, outPaths.readbackOut, artifacts.readback);
+}
+
+async function main() {
+  const artifacts = buildPostAttemptReviewPayloadFrontendHandoff();
+  writePostAttemptReviewPayloadFrontendHandoffArtifacts({
+    outRoot: repoRootFromScript(),
+    artifacts,
+  });
+  const output = {
+    schema_version: 'post_attempt_review_payload_frontend_handoff_cli_result.v1',
+    issue: ISSUE,
+    validator_status: artifacts.validatorResult.validator_status,
+    output_artifacts: artifacts.handoff.output_artifacts,
+    check_count: artifacts.validatorResult.summary.check_count,
+    check_fail_count: artifacts.validatorResult.summary.check_fail_count,
+  };
+  process.stdout.write(`${JSON.stringify(output, null, 2)}\n`);
+  if (artifacts.validatorResult.validator_status !== 'pass') process.exitCode = 1;
+}
